decisions.embeddingCoverage: measured over the population the embedder can act on (the symbol kinds that appear in the embedding table), counting DISTINCT entities
decisions.partialIndex: indexed_files < total_files in brain_index_status is the one incompleteness signal that survives the writing process dying
decisions.concurrency: refresh jobs are serialized per project; the record of a detached outcome is per project and replaced, not stacked
decisions.scale: selection is O(files) in memory by design; sized here rather than assumed

limitations: The multi-model case is proven by direct table manipulation, not by running a second embedding provider — the fixture cannot produce a second model without one.
The concurrency checks are single-process. Cross-process serialization is the index lock's job (script/m43/verify-p1-index-lock.ts), not this gate's.
